name: Accounts CRUD and Detail View Workflow
description: Verify Account Creation, Search filtering, and Detail Page loading

planSteps.description: Navigate to /register and register a new company 'Accounts Test Corp' with user 'sprite_acc@example.com'
Navigate to /accounts, click New Account button, enter name 'Acme TestSprite Global', domain 'acmetestsprite.com', industry 'Software', and click Create Account
Verify Acme TestSprite Global appears in the accounts table list
Click on Acme TestSprite Global in the table
Verify redirection to /accounts/:id detail page with company title Acme TestSprite Global
